name.ja: クリスチャン・バーナード

overview.en: Christiaan Barnard was a South African cardiac surgeon who performed the world's first successful human-to-human heart transplant.

early_life.en: Born in Beaufort West, Cape Province, he studied medicine at the University of Cape Town and trained in cardiac surgery at the University of Minnesota.

impact.en: His pioneering heart transplant opened the era of organ transplantation and transformed cardiac surgery from an experimental field into a life-saving practice.

event.en: Performed the world's first human-to-human heart transplant at Groote Schuur Hospital
Performed the first heterotopic heart transplant

description.en: Autobiography describing his path to the first heart transplant

text.en: It is infinitely better to transplant a heart than to bury it to be devoured by worms.

quotes.source: Press conference after the first heart transplant
